questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: Birchhaven sells pet supplies whose demand is unpredictable and whose variety changes quickly. Which supply chain strategy fits best?

options.text: A lean supply chain focused only on minimizing cost
options.misconception: Prioritizes efficiency over responsiveness to change

options.text: A make-to-stock strategy with large finished-goods buffers
options.misconception: Uses bulky inventory that poorly fits volatile demand

options.text: A single-source strategy with long fixed contracts
options.misconception: Reduces flexibility when demand shifts

options.text: An agile supply chain that prioritizes responsiveness

questions.explanation: An agile supply chain emphasizes speed and flexibility to cope with volatile, varied demand. Lean supply chains excel when demand is stable and efficiency dominates, while rigid sourcing and large buffers reduce responsiveness.
questions.hint: Unpredictable demand calls for responsiveness, not just low cost.

questions.stem: Birchpeak uses 60 units of specialty coffee a day. Its supplier sometimes takes 10 extra days to deliver. How much safety stock covers that variability?
questions.explanation: Safety stock for a lead-time variation is daily demand times the extra days of lead time: 60 units per day times 10 extra days equals 600 units. Holding that buffer prevents a stockout when deliveries run late.
questions.hint: Multiply daily demand by the extra lead-time days.
